products.name: Security Solutions
products.description: A suite of cybersecurity products and services, including web application firewall, bot management, DDoS protection, DNS security, API security, microsegmentation, and Zero Trust Network Security, delivered via Akamai's distributed global infrastructure and managed security services.

products.name: Cloud Computing Services
products.description: Cloud infrastructure and platform services for building, deploying, and scaling distributed, low-latency applications, including compute, storage, networking, serverless functions, and AI inference, delivered via Akamai's global core and edge infrastructure.

products.name: Web and Mobile Performance Solutions
products.description: Performance optimization services for dynamic websites and applications, including site acceleration, load balancing, global traffic management, and real-user monitoring, leveraging Akamai's distributed network to ensure rapid response times and reliability.

products.name: Media Delivery Solutions
products.description: Digital media distribution services, including video streaming, video player services, game and software delivery, and broadcast operations, designed to deliver high-quality live and on-demand content globally with reliability and performance.

products.name: Professional Services and Support
products.description: Consulting, integration, optimization, and managed support services to assist customers in deploying, configuring, and managing Akamai's core offerings, including premium and managed security support.

products.name: Model-Informed Drug Development (MIDD) Software
products.description: A suite of biosimulation software platforms that use mechanistic and AI/ML models to predict and simulate drug absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, toxicity, efficacy, and safety across the drug development lifecycle. Delivered digitally via on-premise or cloud-hosted models to pharmaceutical, biotech, and related industries.

products.name: Scientific Consulting Services for Drug Development
products.description: Expert consulting services providing modeling and simulation expertise (PBPK, QSP, PKPD), clinical trial design, regulatory support, and decision-making guidance throughout the drug discovery, development, and commercialization process. Delivered by scientific staff to clients lacking in-house expertise or capacity.

products.name: Clinical Trial Operations Solutions
products.description: Software and consulting solutions to enhance clinical trial operations, including participant diversity, retention, protocol compliance, and adaptive learning/training platforms for site/investigator education. Delivered digitally and through expert services to optimize trial execution and compliance.

products.name: Commercialization and Medical Communications Solutions
products.description: Software and consulting services supporting regulatory submissions, market intelligence, KOL research, and commercialization strategies for new therapies. Delivered via digital dashboards and expert consulting to facilitate product approval and market launch.

products.name: Self-Storage Facility Leasing
products.description: Leasing of storage spaces to personal and business customers on a month-to-month basis, delivered through a network of physical self-storage facilities operated and managed by the company.

products.name: Tenant Reinsurance Programs
products.description: Provision and administration of insurance programs for tenants to cover losses to stored goods, with the company fully reinsuring the policies through a wholly-owned subsidiary.

products.name: Third-Party Self-Storage Management Services
products.description: Management of self-storage facilities owned by third parties, providing operational expertise, brand, and technology platform in exchange for management fees.

products.name: Bridge Lending to Self-Storage Owners
products.description: Origination of bridge loans to third-party self-storage owners, collateralized by operating self-storage properties, typically with multi-year terms and variable interest rates.

products.name: Self-Storage Merchandise Sales
products.description: Sale of storage-related merchandise such as locks and cardboard boxes at self-storage facilities to support customers’ storage needs.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering and Processing Services
products.description: Aggregation, compression, treating, and cryogenic processing of raw natural gas from oil and gas wells to produce merchantable natural gas and extract NGLs, delivered via extensive pipeline and plant infrastructure.

products.name: Crude Oil Gathering and Terminaling Services
products.description: Pipeline-based aggregation, storage, and terminaling of crude oil from production sites, including operational storage terminals and delivery to pipelines, rail, or truck for further transport.

products.name: NGL Transportation and Pipeline Services
products.description: Transportation of mixed and purity NGLs via company-owned and joint venture pipelines, connecting gathering and processing assets to fractionation and storage hubs, including interstate and intrastate regulated pipelines.

products.name: NGL Fractionation Services
products.description: Separation of mixed NGLs into discrete products (ethane, propane, butanes, natural gasoline) at large-scale fractionation facilities, primarily located in Mont Belvieu, Texas, and Lake Charles, Louisiana.

products.name: NGL Storage and Terminaling Services
products.description: Provision of underground and above-ground storage and terminaling for mixed NGLs and NGL products, including marine, rail, and truck loading/unloading at major hubs and export terminals.

products.name: NGL Marketing and Distribution
products.description: Purchase, resale, and marketing of NGL products (including propane, butanes, natural gasoline) to petrochemical, industrial, commercial, and export customers, utilizing logistics and transportation assets for delivery.

products.name: Wholesale Domestic Propane Marketing
products.description: Sale and logistics of propane to major multi-state retailers, independent retailers, and end-users, sourced from refinery/gas supply contracts and company-owned logistics assets, with delivery via terminals and transportation infrastructure.

products.name: Refinery NGL Services
products.description: Provision of NGL balancing, supply, and marketing services to refineries, including purchasing/marketing propane and supplying butanes, using transportation and storage assets to manage refinery NGL product demand and production schedules.

products.name: Commercial Transportation Services for NGLs
products.description: Fee-based transportation of NGLs and related products for third-party customers using a fleet of railcars, trucks, and barges, supporting delivery to refineries, petrochemical companies, and distribution terminals.

products.name: Natural Gas Marketing
products.description: Purchase, resale, and logistics management of natural gas available from gathering and processing operations, including scheduling and delivery to selected U.S. markets.

products.name: Metallurgical Coal
products.description: High-quality metallurgical coal produced from multiple mining complexes in West Virginia and Virginia, processed at company-owned preparation plants and delivered via rail and other logistics to domestic and international steel and coke producers. Production involves underground, surface, and highwall mining methods, followed by coal preparation and blending.

products.name: Rare Earth Elements and Critical Minerals
products.description: Extraction and planned commercial production of rare earth elements and critical minerals (including neodymium, praseodymium, dysprosium, terbium, yttrium, gallium, germanium, and scandium) from unconventional deposits in coal seams and carbonaceous clays at the Brook Mine in Wyoming. Production involves mining, ore processing, and development of refining capabilities.

products.name: Advanced Carbon Products and Materials
products.description: Research, development, and potential commercialization of advanced carbon products and materials derived from coal, supported by a dedicated carbon research facility. Production involves proprietary processes to convert coal into higher-value carbon-based materials for industrial applications.

products.name: Coal Processing and Blending Services for Third Parties
products.description: Processing and shipping of coal produced by third-party operators at company-owned preparation plants, primarily at the Knox Creek Complex. This service involves coal washing, blending, and logistics for external coal producers.

products.name: High-Density Colocation Services
products.description: Provision of large-scale, purpose-built data center space, power, cooling, and facility operations to third-party customers for high-performance computing (HPC) and artificial intelligence (AI) workloads. Delivered through physical infrastructure, with contracts typically based on power capacity and long-term leases.

products.name: Digital Asset Self-Mining
products.description: Operation of proprietary digital asset mining equipment (primarily for bitcoin) within owned data centers, earning digital assets for the company's own account. Requires significant capital investment in specialized hardware and access to reliable, low-cost power.

products.name: Digital Asset Mining Hosting Services
products.description: Hosting services for third-party digital asset miners, including deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and provision of power and infrastructure to support customer-owned mining equipment. Delivered through physical data center infrastructure and recurring service contracts.

products.name: Investment Banking Services
products.description: Comprehensive advisory services including mergers and acquisitions, equity and debt financings, private placements, restructuring, and capital advisory, primarily for middle-market clients across various sectors. Delivered through in-person expertise and regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Public Finance Services
products.description: Underwriting of municipal issuances, municipal financial advisory, loan placement, and derivative products for government and non-profit clients, delivered through regulated financial professionals and infrastructure.

products.name: Equity and Fixed Income Institutional Brokerage
products.description: Advisory and trade execution services for equity and fixed income products, including sales, trading, and portfolio solutions for institutional investors, corporations, and public entities, delivered via regulated trading platforms and human expertise.

products.name: Equity and Macro Research Services
products.description: Provision of fundamental equity research and macroeconomic research, offering investment ideas and analysis on companies and global trends to institutional clients, delivered digitally and through analyst expertise.

products.name: Alternative Asset Management Funds
products.description: Management of alternative investment funds in merchant banking and healthcare, investing firm and outside investor capital, delivered through regulated asset management entities and investment professionals.

products.name: Full-Service Restaurant Dining
products.description: Operation of company-owned and franchised full-service restaurants under multiple brands, offering prepared food and beverages (including alcoholic beverages) for on-premises consumption, with some locations also offering takeout and delivery. This business requires physical restaurant locations, in-person human labor, regulated food and alcohol service, and supply chain management.

products.name: Franchise and Licensing Services
products.description: Provision of franchise and area development agreements for select restaurant brands, allowing independent third parties to operate restaurants using Darden's trademarks, systems, and support, in exchange for royalties and fees. This is a contractual service business with regulatory and brand management requirements.

products.name: Retail Food Product Licensing
products.description: Licensing of branded food products, such as Olive Garden salad dressings, croutons, and seasonings, for sale through wholesale and grocery channels. This is a brand extension business leveraging intellectual property and third-party manufacturing/distribution.

products.name: Asian Specialty Grocery Retail
products.description: Operation of retail supermarkets and satellite stores offering a wide range of Asian specialty groceries, including fresh produce, meat, seafood, and non-perishable items, sourced from local, regional, and overseas suppliers. Products are delivered through physical stores and integrated online/offline channels, with options for in-store shopping, home delivery, and in-store pickup.

products.name: Ready-to-Eat and Ready-to-Cook Foods
products.description: Provision of ready-to-eat hot foods and ready-to-cook groceries, including frozen foods and prewashed/pre-cut meats and vegetables, prepared in built-in kitchens at select stores and targeted at younger, convenience-focused customers. Delivered through in-store purchase and online ordering for pickup or delivery.

products.name: Online Grocery Shopping and Delivery Services
products.description: Digital ordering and fulfillment services for groceries and prepared foods via third-party mobile apps and WeChat applets, offering home delivery and in-store pickup, supported by in-house logistics and a center-satellite store network for fast, same-day delivery within a defined radius.

products.name: Wholesale Distribution of Asian Food and Groceries
products.description: Wholesale supply of Asian food and grocery products, including imported goods from Asia, to supermarkets and wholesalers across the United States, leveraging an integrated ecosystem of import, customs clearance, and warehousing services.

products.name: Influenza Antiviral Therapeutics
products.description: Small molecule antiviral drugs, including oral and inhaled formulations, developed using proprietary structure-based drug design to treat and prevent influenza A and B infections. These therapeutics target highly conserved viral replication enzymes and are delivered as oral pills or inhaled powders, requiring clinical manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: Norovirus and Coronavirus Antiviral Therapeutics
products.description: Oral small molecule pan-viral antiviral drugs, such as CDI-988, designed to inhibit highly conserved viral proteases for the treatment and prevention of norovirus and coronavirus (including SARS-CoV-2 and its variants) infections. These are developed using proprietary structure-based drug discovery and are delivered as oral medications, requiring clinical trials and regulatory approval.

products.name: Hepatitis C Antiviral Therapeutics
products.description: Oral small molecule direct-acting antiviral drugs, such as CC-31244, targeting the NS5B polymerase for the treatment of hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection. These are developed for use in ultra-short combination regimens (4-6 weeks) and require pharmaceutical manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: Coolers & Equipment
products.description: A range of high-performance coolers and outdoor equipment, including hard coolers (rotomolded or injection-molded), soft cooler bags, various types of bags (everyday, travel, pursuit), cargo and storage solutions, and outdoor living products. These are physically manufactured using advanced materials and construction techniques for durability and performance.

products.name: Drinkware
products.description: Durable, insulated drinkware products including bottles, jugs, cups, mugs, tumblers, tableware, coffeeware, barware, containers, and cookware. Most are made from kitchen-grade stainless steel with double-wall vacuum insulation and are manufactured for temperature retention and durability.

products.name: Apparel and Branded Accessories
products.description: A line of YETI-branded apparel such as hats, shirts, and sweatshirts, as well as branded accessories including ice substitutes and other miscellaneous products. These are sourced and distributed as physical goods to customers.

products.name: Net Lease Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Acquisition, ownership, and leasing of freestanding commercial properties under long-term net lease agreements to a diversified base of external clients across retail, industrial, gaming, and other sectors. Properties are typically leased with clients responsible for property-level operating expenses, while Realty Income receives contractually defined rental payments.

products.name: Real Estate Credit Investments
products.description: Provision of loans and preferred equity investments secured by real estate, complementing core property ownership activities. These credit investments are structured to provide attractive risk-adjusted returns and diversify revenue streams.

products.name: Private Capital Real Estate Investment Management
products.description: Management of joint ventures, private funds, and co-investment vehicles with third-party institutional partners, investing alongside external capital in real estate assets and earning recurring asset management fees.

products.name: Cytisinicline for Smoking Cessation
products.description: A prescription pharmaceutical tablet developed and manufactured for the treatment of nicotine dependence in adults seeking to quit combustible cigarette smoking. The product is produced through extraction and purification of cytisinicline from natural plant sources, followed by formulation into oral tablets, and is delivered via prescription after regulatory approval.

products.name: Cytisinicline for Nicotine E-cigarette (Vaping) Cessation
products.description: A prescription pharmaceutical tablet developed and manufactured for the treatment of nicotine dependence in adults seeking to quit e-cigarette (vaping) use. The product is produced through extraction and purification of cytisinicline from natural plant sources, formulated into oral tablets, and is delivered via prescription after regulatory approval for this indication.

products.name: Commercial Insurance
products.description: Underwriting and sale of commercial property and casualty insurance products, including excess and surplus lines, admitted lines, and specialty personal lines, primarily through independent agents, brokers, and MGAs. Products are tailored by industry, geography, and risk profile, and require regulated infrastructure and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Specialty Insurance
products.description: Provision of specialized insurance coverages for niche industries and unique risks, including professional liability, cyber risk, environmental, healthcare, entertainment, technology, and high net worth personal lines. Delivered via specialized underwriting teams and digital platforms, often requiring deep industry knowledge and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Regional Insurance
products.description: Offering standard and specialized commercial insurance products and services tailored to the needs of small-to-midsized businesses in specific U.S. regions, leveraging local expertise and distribution through independent agents.

products.name: Accident and Health Insurance
products.description: Underwriting and sale of accident and health insurance and reinsurance products, including medical stop loss, managed care, special risk, and group captive solutions, serving employers, healthcare organizations, and membership groups. Requires actuarial, underwriting, and claims management expertise.

products.name: Surety Bonds
products.description: Issuance of surety bonds for construction, environmental, and commercial accounts in the U.S. and Canada, distributed through independent agencies and brokers. Involves underwriting of financial and performance risks and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Reinsurance (Treaty and Facultative)
products.description: Provision of treaty and facultative reinsurance solutions to other insurance companies and self-insureds globally, covering property and casualty risks. Delivered through brokers and direct channels, requiring significant financial capital and risk management expertise.

products.name: Monoline Excess Insurance
products.description: Offering monoline excess insurance products, primarily excess workers’ compensation and excess liability, to large employers and specialized clients. Involves underwriting of high-severity, low-frequency risks and is distributed through agencies and brokers.

products.name: Program Management Services
products.description: Providing insurance support and program management for program administrators, including turnkey offerings, underwriting, claims, and actuarial consultation services. Delivered to commercial casualty and property program administrators nationwide.

products.name: Fee-Based Claims, Administrative, and Consulting Services
products.description: Provision of fee-based services such as claims management, administrative support, and risk consulting to external clients, including public entity pools, professional associations, and self-insured groups. Delivered via specialized service units and third-party administration.

products.name: Retail Casino Gaming
products.description: Operation of land-based and dockside casinos offering slot machines, table games, poker, and live sports betting, often integrated with hotels, dining, entertainment, and meeting facilities. Requires significant physical infrastructure, regulatory licensing, and in-person human labor.

products.name: Racetrack and Simulcast Wagering Operations
products.description: Operation and management of live horse and greyhound racing tracks, including thoroughbred, standardbred, and quarter horse racing, as well as simulcast wagering facilities. Involves regulated physical venues and live events.

products.name: Video Gaming Terminal (VGT) Route Operations
products.description: Provision and management of video gaming terminals in third-party locations such as truck stops, bars, and retail establishments, requiring regulatory approval and route management.

products.name: Online Sports Betting (OSB)
products.description: Provision of digital sports betting services via proprietary online platforms and mobile apps, operating in multiple U.S. states and Ontario, Canada. Requires technology infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and digital marketing.

products.name: Online Casino (iCasino)
products.description: Provision of online casino gaming, including slots, table games, and live dealer content, through proprietary websites and mobile apps in select U.S. states and Ontario, Canada. Delivered digitally and regulated by gaming authorities.

products.name: Social Gaming Content
products.description: Development and operation of social gaming content, including free-to-play casino-style games, primarily delivered digitally via apps and websites. Produced by in-house studios and distributed online.

products.name: Retail Sportsbook Management Services
products.description: Provision of management services for retail (in-person) sportsbooks at both company-owned and third-party casino properties, leveraging proprietary technology and operational expertise. Requires regulatory approval and in-person operations.

products.name: Sports Media Content and Platforms
products.description: Operation of digital sports media platforms, including theScore media app, providing live scores, news, stats, and betting information to users. Delivered digitally and monetized through advertising and cross-sell to gaming products.

products.name: Hotel, Food, Beverage, and Entertainment Services
products.description: Provision of hotel accommodations, dining, bars, event spaces, and live entertainment at casino and racetrack properties. Requires physical infrastructure, hospitality staff, and event management.

products.name: Robotic-Assisted Surgical Systems (da Vinci Surgical Systems)
products.description: Physically manufactured robotic platforms (including da Vinci 5, X, Xi, SP, Si models) enabling minimally invasive surgery across multiple specialties. Delivered as capital equipment to hospitals and surgical centers, requiring installation and ongoing support.

products.name: Robotic-Assisted Endoluminal System (Ion Endoluminal System)
products.description: Physically manufactured, flexible robotic platform for minimally invasive lung biopsies and diagnostic procedures. Delivered as capital equipment to hospitals, with associated instruments and accessories.

products.name: Surgical Instruments and Accessories (da Vinci and Ion)
products.description: Manufactured, procedure-specific instruments (e.g., forceps, scissors, staplers, energy devices) and accessories (e.g., drapes, endoscopes) designed for use with da Vinci and Ion systems. Sold as consumables and reusables to hospitals for each procedure.

products.name: Training and Learning Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive training programs and digital learning platforms (e.g., Intuitive Learning, SimNow) for surgeons and care teams, delivered via in-person courses, simulation, and online modules. Sold as services and software subscriptions to hospitals and clinicians.

products.name: Customer Service and Support (Installation, Maintenance, Technical Support)
products.description: Field service, repair, maintenance, and technical support services for installed systems, including readiness support, software upgrades, and proactive health monitoring. Delivered as service contracts and on-demand services to hospitals and surgical centers.

products.name: Perioperative Consulting and Program Analytics
products.description: Consulting services and analytics solutions to optimize hospital robotics programs, including workflow integration, efficiency assessments, and data-driven decision support. Delivered as professional services and analytics software to healthcare institutions.

products.name: Digital Solutions and Data Platforms (including My Intuitive, My Intuitive+, Case Insights)
products.description: Cloud-enabled digital platforms and applications providing data analytics, workflow orchestration, benchmarking, and performance tracking for surgical programs and clinicians. Delivered as software and subscription services to hospitals and surgeons.

products.name: 3D Modeling Services (Intuitive 3D Models)
products.description: Augmented reality imaging service that converts CT/MR scans into 3D segmented models for pre-operative planning, intraoperative visualization, and surgical education. Delivered as a digital service to hospitals and surgeons.

products.name: Universal Smart Instrumentation Platform (USIP) and Ubiquitor Devices
products.description: A modular hardware and software platform integrating cloud, wired/wireless communication, AI, PLC, and sensor networking for measurement, control, and automation. Devices like the Ubiquitor allow users to connect multiple sensors and instruments from various vendors, with plug-and-play operation and universal display via smartphones or computers. Assembled in-house and distributed to industrial and consumer markets.

products.name: Scientific and Industrial Sensors
products.description: A broad selection of digital sensors (e.g., quantum PAR, pH, TDS, dissolved oxygen, pressure, ORP, temperature, humidity, CO2, water level, chlorine, turbidity) designed for agriculture, aquaculture, beverage, and other industries. Sensors are sold individually or bundled with Ubiquitor devices, manufactured and assembled in-house.

products.name: Smart Home and Building Automation Systems
products.description: Integrated IoT-based systems for residential and commercial customers, including smart lighting, air conditioning, sprinkler, garden light, garage door, heating, swimming pool, smoke, and carbon monoxide controls. Delivered via installation services and leveraging the USIP and Ubiquitor devices for centralized control and automation.

products.name: Large Format Multimedia Touch Screens and LED Displays
products.description: Smart AVX-branded large format multimedia touch screens and indoor/outdoor LED screens for commercial and residential use, including integration with IoT and automation systems. Products are marketed and sold directly and via online channels.

products.name: Surveillance Camera Systems
products.description: Smart AVX-branded surveillance camera systems, including cameras and network video recorders (NVRs), for security and monitoring applications in homes and businesses. Sold as standalone systems or integrated with automation platforms.

products.name: VOIP Phone Service Systems
products.description: Focus Universal-branded VOIP phone service systems for business and residential customers, providing internet-based telephony solutions. Marketed via sales staff and online channels.

products.name: SEC Financial Reporting Software (One Touch Financial)
products.description: AI-enabled software for automating SEC financial reporting, designed for accounting professionals and firms. Delivered as a SaaS product, it retrieves financial data and generates reports in multiple formats with minimal human intervention.

products.name: OEM Engineering Consulting and Design Services
products.description: Consulting and design services for OEM customers to implement universal smart technology in industrial applications, including on-site engineering support and product design to accelerate time-to-market for new products.

products.name: Technology Licensing
products.description: Licensing of proprietary universal smart technology, USIP, and PLC intellectual property to third-party manufacturers and technology companies, enabling integration into their own products and systems.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a wide range of commercial loans, including loans to small businesses (including SBA-guaranteed), professionals, and companies, primarily within Texas. Lending is delivered through in-person bankers at full-service banking centers, supported by centralized credit approval and risk management processes.

products.name: Retail Lending
products.description: Offers mortgage loans, home equity loans, personal loans, and automobile loans to individual customers, primarily in Texas, delivered through banking centers and digital channels.

products.name: Factoring Services
products.description: Provides factoring services (purchase of accounts receivable) to businesses through a wholly owned subsidiary, involving financial capital and specialized underwriting.

products.name: Deposit Products
products.description: Offers a variety of deposit accounts including checking, commercial, money market, savings, and time deposits to both business and individual customers, delivered via physical branches and digital banking platforms. Deposits are FDIC insured.

products.name: Cash Management and Treasury Services
products.description: Provides cash management, wire transfer, and treasury services to business customers, leveraging digital platforms and in-person support to facilitate business banking operations.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Delivers online and mobile banking services, including account access, deposits, fund transfers, bill payment, and electronic statements, to both business and individual customers via digital platforms.

products.name: Other Ancillary Banking Services
products.description: Provides additional banking services such as safe deposit boxes, debit cards, night depository, direct deposits, cashier’s checks, and letters of credit, primarily through physical branches.

products.name: Pizza and Related Food and Beverage Products
products.description: Papa Johns produces and sells pizza and a variety of complementary food and beverage products through company-owned and franchised restaurants. These products are prepared in physical restaurant locations and delivered to customers via carryout, delivery, and, in some international markets, dine-in service.

products.name: Restaurant Franchising
products.description: Papa Johns sells franchise and development rights, and collects royalties from franchisees who operate restaurants under the Papa Johns brand. This business line involves providing operational support, brand standards, and marketing to external franchise operators.

products.name: Food and Restaurant Supply Distribution (Commissary Services)
products.description: Papa Johns operates regional dough production and distribution centers (QC Centers) that manufacture and distribute pizza dough, sauce, food products, paper products, and cleaning supplies to company-owned and franchised restaurants. This involves physical manufacturing and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Restaurant Technology Solutions
products.description: Papa Johns sells information systems and related services, including point-of-sale systems and online ordering platforms, primarily to company-owned and franchised restaurants. These are digital products and services supporting restaurant operations.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Production and Sales
products.description: Production of renewable natural gas by capturing and processing biogas from landfills and dairy farms, upgrading it to pipeline-quality RNG, and selling it as a fuel for transportation, industrial, and consumer uses. This involves physical manufacturing, regulated infrastructure, and distribution via pipelines or tube trailers.

products.name: Renewable Power Generation and Sales
products.description: Generation of electricity from biogas (primarily landfill gas and dairy waste) at Renewable Power plants, with electricity sold to public utilities through power purchase agreements. This requires physical plant operation, regulated infrastructure, and grid interconnection.

products.name: Fueling Station Construction, Operation, and Services
products.description: Design, development, construction, operation, and maintenance of fueling stations for trucking fleets and other customers, including both RNG and hydrogen fueling stations. This includes in-house manufacturing of modular CNG compressor packages and providing ongoing service and support.

products.name: RNG Dispensing and Marketing Services
products.description: Dispensing and marketing of RNG as a transportation fuel through a network of fueling stations, including the generation and sale of associated Environmental Attributes (e.g., RINs, LCFS credits) to obligated parties and other market participants. This is a service-based business leveraging physical and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Environmental Attributes Monetization
products.description: Generation and sale of Environmental Attributes (such as RINs, LCFS credits, ISCC Carbon Credits, and RECs) associated with the production and dispensing of RNG and Renewable Power, sold to obligated parties and other buyers for regulatory compliance and market incentives. This is a digital/financial product tied to physical fuel and power sales.

products.name: Hydrogen Fueling Station Construction and Services
products.description: Design, development, and construction of hydrogen fueling stations for vehicle fleets, including providing RNG for hydrogen production. This is an emerging business line involving physical infrastructure and engineering services.

products.name: Casual Apparel
products.description: A broad assortment of casual clothing for young men, young women, boys, and girls, including tops, outerwear, bottoms, swimwear, and dresses, sourced from both third-party and proprietary brands. Products are physically manufactured and distributed through retail stores and online channels.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: A wide selection of casual and lifestyle footwear for young men, young women, boys, and girls, featuring iconic global, emerging, and proprietary brands. Footwear is physically manufactured and sold through both retail stores and online platforms.

products.name: Accessories
products.description: A diverse range of accessories such as backpacks, hydration bottles, hats, sunglasses, handbags, watches, and jewelry, offered from both third-party and proprietary brands. These are physical products sold in stores and online.

products.name: Hardgoods
products.description: Select hardgoods related to the active, outdoor, and social lifestyle of the target demographic, including items such as skateboards and related equipment, sourced from third-party and proprietary brands. These are physical products sold in stores and online.

products.name: Network-on-Chip (NoC) Interconnect IP
products.description: Configurable, silicon-proven interconnect intellectual property (IP) for managing on-chip communications in System-on-Chip (SoC) and chiplet designs. Delivered as hardware IP blocks and associated configuration software, enabling integration of processors, memory, and logic with high performance and efficiency. Includes non-coherent (FlexGen, FlexNoC, FlexWay) and cache-coherent (Ncore) variants, as well as optional resilience and performance packages.

products.name: NoC Interface IP
products.description: Add-on semiconductor IP blocks that attach to NoC interconnects, such as last-level cache (CodaCache), memory schedulers, SoC data observability, and debug IPs. Delivered as hardware IP and configuration software to enhance SoC performance, data latency, and debug capabilities.

products.name: SoC Integration Automation Software Solutions
products.description: Software suite for automating the integration, packaging, and assembly of IP blocks into SoC designs, based on industry standards like IP-XACT (IEEE 1685). Includes tools for hardware/software interface generation, register configuration, and design documentation (e.g., Magillem Connectivity, Magillem Registers, CSRCompiler). Delivered as licensed software to semiconductor and system companies.

products.name: Hardware Security Verification Software
products.description: Software tools for hardware security verification and analysis of semiconductor IP, subsystems, and SoCs. Includes simulation, emulation, and static analysis products (e.g., Cycuity Radix-S, Radix-M, Radix-ST) to identify and remediate security vulnerabilities during chip design. Delivered as licensed software to semiconductor and system companies.

products.name: Commercial Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of office and industrial properties to a diverse base of commercial tenants. Properties are physically owned, managed, and leased, requiring property management, leasing, and maintenance services.

products.name: Model Home Sale-Leaseback Program
products.description: Acquisition of new single-family model homes from homebuilders and leasing them back under triple net leases for use in marketing residential developments. Properties are physically purchased and managed, with leases to homebuilders and eventual sale to third parties.

products.name: Property Management Services
products.description: Provision of property management services for owned and affiliated properties, including on-site management and subcontracting with third-party management companies. Delivered through in-person human labor and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Water Valves and Related Products
products.description: Manufactures and sells a range of valves for water systems, including iron gate, butterfly, tapping, check, knife, plug, and ball valves, as well as service brass products. These are physically manufactured in foundries and machining facilities and delivered through distributors to utilities and contractors.

products.name: Fire Hydrants
products.description: Manufactures dry-barrel and wet-barrel fire hydrants for water infrastructure development, fire protection, and repair projects. These are produced in manufacturing facilities and distributed primarily to municipalities and contractors.

products.name: Pipe Repair Products and Services
products.description: Produces and sells pipe repair products such as couplings, grips, and clamps, and provides repair and installation services. These are manufactured and delivered to utilities for maintenance and emergency repairs.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Products
products.description: Manufactures machines, tools, and gas valve products for tapping, drilling, extracting, installing, and line stopping in gas distribution systems. These are physically produced and sold to gas utilities and contractors.

products.name: Water Leak Detection and Pipe Condition Assessment Products and Services

products.name: Water Metering Products and Systems
products.description: Manufactures and sources water meters and metering systems, including manually read and radio-read (AMR/AMI) meters for residential, commercial, and fire protection applications. products.name: Pressure Management and Control Products and Solutions
products.description: Provides pressure control valves, advanced pressure management, network analytics, event management, and data logging solutions for water systems. These are manufactured and delivered as both hardware and digital solutions to utilities.

products.name: Apparel and Accessories

products.name: Personal Care Products
products.description: Sells personal care products such as fragrances and body care items under its brands, produced by third-party vendors and distributed through retail and online channels.

products.name: Private Label and Co-Branded Credit Card Programs

products.name: Franchise and Licensing Services

products.name: Gift Cards and Loyalty Program

products.name: Antibody Biopolymer Conjugate Drug (ABCD) Platform Therapies

products.name: ETH Treasury Management Services

products.name: Condominium Hotel Rental Programs
products.description: Operation of rental programs for individually owned condominium units within condominium hotel properties, where the company manages or contracts management for the rental of these units to guests. products.name: Leasing of Commercial Space within Hotels
products.description: Leasing of retail, restaurant, and other commercial spaces within hotel properties to third-party tenants, generating ancillary revenue streams. This involves physical property management and tenant agreements.

products.name: Commercial Residential Property Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage for owners and operators of multi-family and other commercial residential properties, distributed via independent agents and managed through proprietary underwriting and claims systems. Requires regulated insurance infrastructure and risk management.

products.name: Commercial General Liability Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage protecting commercial residential property owners against liability claims, underwritten and serviced through regulated insurance subsidiaries and agent networks. Delivered via traditional insurance infrastructure.

products.name: Wind-Only Property Insurance

products.name: Solid Bleached Sulfate (SBS) Paperboard
products.description: Premium paperboard manufactured using virgin fiber and kraft bleaching, primarily supplied in rolls or sheets to independent converters for use in folding cartons, food service packaging, and commercial printing. products.name: Custom Sheeting and Slitting Services
products.description: Conversion services that cut and slit paperboard rolls into custom sizes for converters, merchants, and commercial printers, enabling just-in-time supply and tailored product formats. Delivered as a value-added service alongside core paperboard products.

products.name: Pulp Sales
